name: azelaic acid
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE AZELEX ® cream is indicated for the topical treatment of mild-to-moderate inflammatory acne vulgaris.
pediatric: Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients under 12 years of age have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS AZELEX ® cream is contraindicated in individuals who have shown hypersensitivity to any of its components.
